card.name: Start of brand names, and short slogans
card.fires_on: The first piece of an uppercase brand name split into parts, such as CY in CYANOKIT or DO in DOVATO. It also fires on 'is' in short emphatic statements like 'Freedom is never free'.

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: The opening piece of a capitalised drug brand name that the text splits into parts.
modes.example: administer<< CY>>ANOKIT without delay and in conjunction

modes.label: Emphatic statement
modes.description: The word 'is' in a short, forceful claim that could end with an exclamation.

modes.label: Start of a split word
modes.description: The first piece of a plain word split into parts, such as 'shoveling' or 'restraints'.
modes.example: by<< sh>>oveling them into the blazing inciner

card.writes: It promotes exclamation marks and suppresses odd rare tokens, which suggests it adds an emphatic sentence ending.
card.plain: It marks the start of a split-up brand name or the verb in a punchy slogan-like sentence.
